31 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, The essay I could not read {#essay}, I wanted to pay for this one {#pay}…

There is an anti-AI mood at the moment, and stories of burnout feed it. I am not dismissing the essay; burnout is real, and I could not read his reasons. But the other story should be told as loudly: that working this way can make you more productive, more in control and happier than you have ever been. That is the story I want people starting out to hear, and it is the one [Generation Z Developers,Developersagain](../../generation-z-developers-again.md)(AI edition)](../../generation-z-developers-again.html) is for.
